fingerprint.algorithm: SHA256 of sorted path + NUL + fileSHA256 + newline records

implemented.geometryAdmission: Admit the original root map and all extent/region/batching arrays, numeric/native DOM wrappers and bound records before their original factories. Count actual vector operations and authored transform matrices; native callbacks, matrix/point math, region union/merge/sort/split/overlap operators and primitive ordering remain unchanged.

declaredCapacity.total: 640 + 2200*N + 192*M + 8*N*(N-1), where N is the actual incoming operation count and M the sum of actual transforms (one fallback when absent). This is a sum of concrete producer capacity bounds, not a scene multiplier.
declaredCapacity.perExtent: At most 1616: 40 original one-op input array; 64 corner header/slots; 64 inline box; 40 fallback transform input; 192 world DOMMatrix wrapper/value; 256 corner tuples; 640 four input point records + four DOMPoint wrapper/values; 256 four coordinate maps; 64 output bounds. Each authored transform adds a 192-byte original DOMMatrix wrapper/value.
declaredCapacity.regionProducerBound: 256 + 320*N + 4*N*(N-1) covers original region/all/next records, root/indices/output arrays, at most N all-bounds unions and N-1 region merges/splice result arrays, and at most N*(N-1)/2 copied merged index slots.
declaredCapacity.drawBatchingBound: 176*N + 4*N*(N-1) covers original overlap slice headers/slots, one-index inputs, mapped operation arrays and painted bounds unions. Original root map header/slots, grouped owner/control and conservative spare capacity fit the total.

implemented.lifetime: The real WebGL backend uses a synchronous bounds consumer: actual geometry remains admitted through GPU painting and the original framebuffer-bounds copy, then its containers/indices/references clear. Without a synchronous consumer, an active frame scratch owns returned geometry until its caller finishes. Previously admitted RasterPart bounds remain independent and retained across geometry cleanup.
implemented.errors: Geometry quota denial precedes original root map/extent/DOM/paint producers. Failed native painting or bounds consumption preserves original errors, including null, and clears temporary geometry while completed original raster cache entries keep their original reuse behavior. No duplicate repaint or retained temporary geometry accumulates.
implemented.scope: Selected vector extent/region/batching geometry and its actual synchronous consumer. Recording/replay internals and other WebGL bounds/device/pool/shader/paint controls remain pending, as do provider keys, retained graphs, font and other checksum structures, ledger controls, Node protocol/result copies and actual production/aggregate admission. Native VM/codec/driver/crypto private storage and RSS are separate.
